fields.name: Position
fields.evidence: Not replicated. Toolkit ls::CameraSystem::SetWorldMapProperties(view, Vector3f const& pos, Vector3f const& target, float, float) (GameEngine.dll+0x6305D0) writes its first vector to +0..+0xB and passes &+0 as the eye position to the camera look-at virtual. Constructor (+0x7D5260): (128, 256, 128).

fields.name: Target
fields.evidence: SetWorldMapProperties writes its second vector to +0xC..+0x17 and passes &+0xC as the look-at target; the distance between the two sets the far plane. Constructor: (128, 0, 128).
